samples.visibleText: ADA MENSAH LOCAL PROTOTYPE · 01 1 / Code → physical check How does code become a physical check? Ada Mensah works with embedded firmware: code that controls a physical device. For Mosslink, an environmental sensor, she wrote the firmware, scheduled its power states and built the bring-up fixture. Bring-up means checking a new board’s basic operation. Follow the apparatus to see how a code decision connects to something observable on the bench. Illustrative apparatus · fictional subject and sensor. headings.text: Make the board accessible.

samples.visibleText: 3 / Open the bench Make the board accessible. A firmware command asks the physical board to act. The bring-up fixture provides access so that its response can be observed on the bench. The fixture helps check behavior; the board’s circuitry still performs the device’s work. Ada: firmware, power-state scheduling and bring-up fixture. A colleague: the PCB (printed circuit board) and analogue front end, the circuitry interfacing with sensor signals. The opened model explains command → board response → fixture access → bench observation. It is not a wiring plan or a public debugging incident. 4 / Read the evidence Two claims. Two

headings.text: Two claims. Two kinds of support.

samples.visibleText: 4 / Read the evidence Two claims. Two kinds of support. Measured sleep and transmit current, together with an assumed reporting interval, support a two-year endurance projection. Separately, the longest continuous bench run was 72 hours: an observed duration. The 72-hour run does not validate two years of endurance. Neither path establishes field conditions or customer deployment. No original measurements, current trace, spreadsheet or run notebook is supplied. Left: measured inputs + assumed interval → projection. Right: continuous bench run → observation. The display labels are explanatory, not recovered instrument readings. 5 / Bound the answer A connection you can check. A claim with limits. Ada’s firmware and scheduling decisions connect to an observable bench check through the fixture she built. That is the contribution this story can support—not ownership of the whole sensor. Forty engineering samples were assembled; six were bench-tested; none went to customers. One preliminary emissions check passed. Full qualification is unfinished. State tables, timing diagrams, current traces and bench checklists are working documents. None is supplied here
